description: The widget library: the only widgets lesson content may name. Each is ordinary, tested app code under src/widgets/; content picks one by name and sets its params. src/widgets/registry.test.ts fails if this list and the app's registry differ.

line-fitter.summary: Fit y = c + mx to a few points: drag the line or use the sliders; live residuals, ‖r‖² and r·(each column); keep guesses in a table to compare.

showDots.description: Show r·(1,…,1) and r·x, which are both zero at the best fit.

table.description: Offer 'Keep this guess' and a table of kept guesses.

revealBest.description: Offer a 'Show the best line' button. Off unless the learner has already found it.

dependent-columns.summary: Two dependent columns: the line of best fits in the (c, m) plane, error level lines parallel to it, a draggable p with ‖r‖² and ‖p‖², and the circle ‖x‖ = ‖p‖.

A.description: A matrix with two columns, the second a multiple of the first.

mode.description: line: p slides along the best-fit line. free: p goes anywhere.

circle.description: Draw the circle through p centred on the origin.

revealMinNorm.description: Mark the minimum-norm point. Off until the learner has found it.

svd-geometry.summary: A 2×2 matrix as rotate, stretch, rotate: the unit circle through Vᵀ, Σ and U to an ellipse, with sliders on σ₁, σ₂ and both angles; optional rank-1 truncation (error σ₂) and the pseudo-inverse's 1/σ rule.

matrix.description: Start from this 2×2 matrix (its SVD is computed). Otherwise from sigma and the angles.

pinv.description: Show what the pseudo-inverse does to each σ.

pca-scatter.summary: A few points and a line through their mean: turn it by a handle or a slider; projections and perpendicular drops drawn, live u, variance along u and mean squared distance to the line; keep guesses in a table; optionally show the principal direction and the perpendicular one.

centre.description: Draw the points minus their mean. Otherwise the raw points, with the mean as a cross.

start.description: The line's starting angle in degrees, anticlockwise from the x-axis.

denominator.description: What sums of squares are divided by: n − 1 (default) or n.

table.description: Offer 'Keep this guess' and a table of kept angles with their variance.

revealBest.description: Offer a 'Show the best direction' button. Off unless the learner has already found it.

showSecond.description: Also draw the perpendicular direction, its variance, and that the two variances add up to the total.

descent-path.summary: Gradient descent on a quadratic bowl f(x) = ½xᵀHx − gᵀx + c: level curves, a draggable start, the path of iterates for the step size η on a slider (or one step per tap), read-outs of η, the last iterate and f there, and whether η is below the limit 2/λmax; or the 1D parabola f = ½λx² with the iterates bouncing on it.

H.description: A symmetric positive-definite 2×2 matrix. With oneD, H[0][0] is λ and the rest is ignored.

g.description: The linear term (default (0, 0)); the bottom of the bowl is where Hx = g.

c.description: The constant term, so the f read-out matches the lesson's f (default 0).

view.description: Half-width of the picture around the bottom of the bowl (with oneD, around 0).

start.description: The start point x₀ (with oneD, its first entry).

eta.description: The step size to start with.

etaRange.description: The η slider's range (default 0 to a little past 2/λmax).

maxSteps.description: How many steps can be shown (default 12).

showGradient.description: Draw −∇f as an arrow at the start point.

stepByStep.description: A 'Take a step' button instead of the steps slider, so the learner predicts, then sees.

revealLimit.description: Offer a 'Show the limit' button that marks 2/λmax under the slider. Off until the learner has found it.

oneD.description: Draw f = ½λx² as a parabola, with λ = H[0][0], and the iterates bouncing on it.
